userStories.title: Add Core Web Vitals optimization: hero image priority and lazy-loading
userStories.description: The Hero component (Hero.tsx) likely uses a large banner image that is the Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) element. Without the `priority` prop on the Next.js Image component, the hero image is lazy-loaded, causing LCP scores above 4s on mobile — a Google ranking signal. Additionally, below-fold images should be explicitly lazy-loaded and sized with the `sizes` attribute to prevent Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS). Target: LCP < 2.5s, CLS < 0.1.

userStories.title: Implement WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 – Target Size Minimum (24×24 CSS px)

userStories.title: Implement INP optimisation: defer non-critical third-party scripts

web-vitals attribution data logged to analytics identifies the specific interaction with highest INP
technicalNotes: Next.js Script strategies: `beforeInteractive` (critical), `afterInteractive` (default), `lazyOnload` (lowest priority), `worker` (Partytown)

userStories.title: Implement WCAG 2.2 SC 3.2.6 – Consistent Help placement (Level A)

userStories.title: Update privacy policy for PDPA 2024 Amendment: breach notification and DPO

userStories.title: Add WCAG 2.2 SC 1.2.2 captions to all prerecorded video content

userStories.title: Implement WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.6 descriptive headings and form labels
